data.title: bn-2vih: adapt rebaseline runner to protocol v4
data.description: Replaces v3 sealed-lineage run-time custody with v4: rehearsal mode (rehearsal-* dirs, non-evidence rows, no coordination, warn-not-fail quiet guard), accepted mode (operator DECLARED.txt naming runner+4 binary SHA-256s + MESS_BENCH_COORDINATION_CONFIRMED), claim record moved into run output (prepared root now reusable), verify_current_runtime exe-identity fail-stop retired (script bound by hash), rehearsal flag threaded through config/provenance with evaluator+verifier cross-check. Measurement core/matrices/gates/correctness/profile tracks/terminal outcomes unchanged. All four self-tests green (runner 160/160 incl 5 new v4 admission cases; evaluator; terminal verifier 187/187; semantic-authority); fmt clean. Commit e72dcf5d tree 9de1d99e.
